import math, os, random
import torch, torch.nn as nn
from model import MLP
from data import make_data


def train(model, train_loader, val_loader, n_epochs=20, lr=1e-3, patience=3, checkpoint_path="checkpoint.pt"):
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
    loss_fn = nn.MSELoss()
    start_epoch, best_metric, best_state, no_improve = 0, math.inf, None, 0
    if os.path.exists(checkpoint_path):
        ck = torch.load(checkpoint_path, weights_only=False)
        model.load_state_dict(ck["model"]); optimizer.load_state_dict(ck["optimizer"])
        start_epoch = ck["epoch"] + 1; best_metric = ck["best_metric"]; best_state = ck["best_state"]
        torch.set_rng_state(ck["torch_rng"]); random.setstate(ck["python_rng"])
    for epoch in range(start_epoch, n_epochs):
        model.train()
        for x, y in train_loader:
            optimizer.zero_grad(); loss = loss_fn(model(x), y); loss.backward(); optimizer.step()
        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val = sum(loss_fn(model(x), y).item() for x, y in val_loader) / len(val_loader)
        if val < best_metric:
            best_metric = val
            best_state = model.state_dict()      # BUG: no clone -> live reference to current weights
            no_improve = 0
        else:
            no_improve += 1
        torch.save({"model": model.state_dict(), "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(), "epoch": epoch,
                    "best_metric": best_metric, "best_state": best_state,
                    "torch_rng": torch.get_rng_state(), "python_rng": random.getstate()}, checkpoint_path)
        print(f"epoch {epoch:02d} | val {val:.4f} | best {best_metric:.4f}")
        if no_improve >= patience: break
    model.load_state_dict(best_state)            # loads the mutated reference = last weights
    return model
